services.name: openclaw
command: set -eu; cfg(){ openclaw config set "$1" "$2" --strict-json >/dev/null; }; ORIGIN_PRIMARY="${APP_PROTOCOL:-http}://${APP_DOMAIN}"; if [ -n "${OPENCLAW_FALLBACK_MODEL_REF:-}" ]; then FALLBACKS="[\"${OPENCLAW_FALLBACK_MODEL_REF}\"]"; else FALLBACKS="[]"; fi; cfg gateway "{\"mode\":\"local\",\"bind\":\"lan\",\"port\":18789,\"auth\":{\"mode\":\"token\",\"token\":\"${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN}\"},\"controlUi\":{\"enabled\":true,\"basePath\":\"/openclaw\",\"allowedOrigins\":[\"$ORIGIN_PRIMARY\"]}}"; cfg models "{\"mode\":\"merge\",\"providers\":{\"ollama\":{\"baseUrl\":\"${OLLAMA_BASE_URL}\",\"api\":\"ollama\",\"apiKey\":\"${OLLAMA_API_KEY}\",\"models\":[]},\"localai\":{\"baseUrl\":\"${LOCALAI_BASE_URL}\",\"api\":\"openai-completions\",\"apiKey\":\"${LOCALAI_API_KEY}\",\"models\":[{\"id\":\"${LOCALAI_MODEL_ID}\",\"name\":\"${LOCALAI_MODEL_NAME}\",\"reasoning\":false,\"input\":[\"text\"],\"cost\":{\"input\":0,\"output\":0,\"cacheRead\":0,\"cacheWrite\":0},\"contextWindow\":${LOCALAI_CONTEXT_WINDOW},\"maxTokens\":${LOCALAI_MAX_TOKENS}}]}}}"; cfg agents.defaults.model "{\"primary\":\"${OPENCLAW_PRIMARY_MODEL_REF}\",\"fallbacks\":$FALLBACKS}"; cfg agents.defaults.memorySearch "{\"provider\":\"ollama\",\"model\":\"${OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL}\",\"fallback\":\"none\"}"; exec openclaw gateway run --allow-unconfigured --bind lan --port 18789
